scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @piflow/protocol run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @piflow/protocol --filter piflow-web --filter piflow-server run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @piflow/protocol run build && pnpm --filter piflow-server run build && pnpm --filter piflow-web run build && node scripts/build-app.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @piflow/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @piflow/protocol run typecheck && pnpm --filter piflow-web run typecheck && pnpm --filter piflow-server run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter piflow-server run test && pnpm --filter piflow-web run test
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:build && pnpm build
